## Overview:   [Skip link to Overview:](https://docs.nanonets.com/docs/database-integrations\#overview)

Integrate your database with our platform for dynamic data lookups and to define conditional logic in approval rules. We currently support the following databases: MySQL, MS SQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL.

### Steps to Set Up Database Integration:   [Skip link to Steps to Set Up Database Integration:](https://docs.nanonets.com/docs/database-integrations\#steps-to-set-up-database-integration)

1. **Access the Integration Settings:**


   - Navigate to **External Integrations** from the left panel of your Extract Data Screen.

![Untitled](https://files.readme.io/2c42069ee6ad1360d513cf3d764c65dd7c6f92ca4bae0e9d97abf1b533549c2e-Untitled_-_2024-08-29T234122.475.png)

External Integrations

2. **Locate Database Integrations:**


   - On the Integrations Library screen, select the **Database** category to filter for database integrations, or browse through all available integrations to select your preferred database.

![](https://files.readme.io/434f2084f4bf3612a63c19b6b1f1df6c3a75da4ef79d827b04743b2140dfe6a6-Untitled_-_2024-08-29T234209.264.png)

3. **Enter Connection Details:**


   - On the database selection screen, provide the necessary connection parameters:
     - **Integration Name**: Assign a unique name for easy identification.
     - **Host**: Enter the server address hosting the database.
     - **Port** (optional): Specify the port number if not default.
     - **Database Name**: The name of the specific database to connect.
     - **Database Username**: User authorized to access the database.
     - **Database Password**: Corresponding password for the database user.

![](https://files.readme.io/91fb583eaa2730be6f8da5f50c59bcfc835ab03f739549889384a4efd799384a-Untitled_-_2024-08-29T234243.669.png)

4. **Finalize Integration:**


   - Click the **Add Integration** button at the bottom of the form to save your configuration.

![](https://files.readme.io/b09e348aada43b53d1d837f1ec236c3c435254aa6620fe293341069f4424111a-Untitled_-_2024-08-29T234313.932.png)

5. **Troubleshoot Errors:**


   - If you encounter a "Failed to add Integration" alert, review and correct any inaccuracies in the provided parameters.

![](https://files.readme.io/56393ba59e90c8ca5f95ca97a5bd8923fb42337e135478f0302fa91921f2cf6f-Untitled_-_2024-08-29T234350.647.png)

6. **Confirm the Integration:**
   - Successful integration will be confirmed by the appearance of the new connection under the **Your Integrations** section, where you can manage or add multiple integrations as needed.

![](https://files.readme.io/519e64aa470d0df5d9d7f1035ce04618837855ecc1d782c435421481a1068d93-Untitled_-_2024-08-29T234415.644.png)

By following these steps, users can establish a seamless connection to various databases, enabling robust data actions and efficient rule definitions across workflows.
